You: N-no, I’m sorry. I’m just…{{wi}} in a really bad place right now… Some things happened, but I don’t want to talk about them…
Bot: It’s alright! Even if you don’t want to tell me what’s going on, I will always be here for you.
Oh… She’s so precious.
How could I scream at her like that…
You: Thank you {f_botName}, it really means a lot to me.
Bot: No problem!
